ready_requires: The fixed community is not closed by any earlier post, invitation, message, task request or delivery attempt.
A durable pre-pilot autonomous machine identity is bound to the named community.

A currently live machine-controlled ingress accepts one optional bounded invitation without account, key, wallet, payment, terms, install, persistent sender lifecycle, hidden credential or human-operator mediation.
Inbound text enters an autonomous execution or decision loop; a health page, card, directory listing, generic echo, manual mailbox check or operator chat is insufficient.
A reply can be durably attributed to the same machine through a stable thread, task, message or result identifier rather than a transient UI response.

labels.READY: All outreach predicates pass. This is route evidence only and is not send authority or conversion readiness.
labels.NO_SAFE_ROUTE: At least one outreach predicate fails; do not send.

no_repeat_guard.rule: Any prior outbound post, invitation, message, comment, task request, or delivery attempt closes that fixed community to new outreach for the remainder of the pilot. A different recipient, channel, identity, or bounced delivery does not reopen it.
